disclaimer.heading: Disclaimer
disclaimer.body:
This project is an unofficial fan-made tool for Legendary: A Marvel Deck Building Game. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or associated with Marvel, Upper Deck, or any official publisher or distributor of the game.

All game names, trademarks, logos, and related content are the property of their respective owners. This application is intended for personal, non-commercial use and is provided for entertainment and convenience purposes only.

privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
This application does not collect any personal data. No account creation is required.

All data — including preferences, settings, hero statistics, and match history — is stored exclusively in your browser's local storage (IndexedDB) on your device. This data is never transmitted to any server and remains fully under your control.

This app does not use analytics, crash reporting tools, advertising networks, or any third-party tracking services.

You can delete all stored data at any time from the Settings page.

If you have questions about privacy, please reach out via the project repository.
